Card Q&A.q: I attack my opponent with a Digimon, and suspend this Tamer. If my opponent blocks the attack, what happens to the +2000 DP bonus from this Tamer's effect?

Effect: [Your Turn] When one of your red Digimon attacks a player, you may suspend this Tamer to give that Digimon +2000 DP for the turn.
